result.brief: 系统比较 patch 派生 token 与 register token 两类变长图像 tokenizer，并分析表征对齐对生成性能与空间结构的影响。
result.reason: Compares variable-length image tokenizers (patch-derived vs register tokens) with representation alignment to pretrained visual encoders, directly addressing tokenizer and generative latent space design.
